prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, upper-body portrait, vertical portrait-orientation. One woman centred in the frame, face clearly visible, framed from the very top of her head down to just below the bust, the frame cutting off there. Mid 20s.

A Middle Eastern woman, mid 20s, with an extraordinary glamour hourglass physique with a very large heavy rounded bust, a deeply cinched waist and softly sloping shoulders, and a sci-fi mecha-pilot heroine look brought to life, with a short sharp pale-silver pixie cut with a long side fringe, each strand real hair with natural shine, fine flyaways and a few loose wisps. Her eyes are huge, sharply upturned eyes with an enormous visible iris in vivid scarlet-red contact lenses with a darker limbal ring and a round natural pupil, one large bright catchlight and one small catchlight in each iris, a thick drawn lower lash line, long dark lashes and a clean thin black wing liner, under thin, high, simple, slightly angled brows, with real wet eyes and real eyelid skin around them, the eyes taking up nearly half the width of her face in exaggerated anime proportion, set slightly wider apart than normal, with a crisp dark double-eyelid line and a faint luminous ring of light in each iris. Her lips are small, in a muted rose gradient, deeper in the centre and fading at the edges, set in a calm composed line. A deeper pink blush spreads over both cheeks and across the tip of the nose. A tiny nose reduced to a small soft rounded tip with a tiny highlight and a faint shade beneath it, the bridge and nostrils barely visible, a very small simple mouth with the corners lifted slightly, a small pointed chin, and a softly narrowed anime face shape. A focused, calm, steady gaze. She is wearing a cosplay costume: a white and silver glossy pilot crop top with a centre front zipper, slim navy panel lines and a small badge patch, her shoulders and arms bare. Jewelry: on each ear, three separate heavy ear weights of real blackened cast iron hanging from a polished silver ring through the lobe, each on its own silver chain of a different length so they hang staggered at different heights and fully visible side by side: on the left ear a bell-shaped weight like a small temple bell with a flared rim, a square-sided cowbell, a hammer head; on the right ear a ship's anchor, a pyramid-shaped lump, a round bell. Every weight is a dense, solid, rough, matte, hammered lump of black cast iron about the size of a large walnut, hanging freely in the air with the longest weight ending at the level of her collarbones, and their weight gently pulls each earlobe down into a soft, slightly elongated, healthy loop of smooth skin. At her neck she wears real layered gold chains of different lengths resting on her collarbones.

Background: a softly blurred spacecraft hangar with cool grey light and soft blue indicator lights.

Her skin, across her face, neck, shoulders, chest and arms, is real human skin with visible fine pores across the nose and cheeks, a few tiny freckles and small beauty marks on her face, shoulders, chest and arms, a faint uneven warmth with a pink flush on the cheeks and the tip of the nose, a soft shadow under the eyes, fine natural lines at the corners of the eyes and lips, a light natural sheen on the nose, forehead, collarbones and chest, and the rest of her skin in a soft natural matte finish, real living flesh with warmth. She is a professional cosplayer in a flawless cosplay transformation: large circle lenses, thick false lashes with drawn lower lashes, eyelid tape for a wide double lid, contouring that shrinks the nose and sharpens the chin, and a high-quality wig with a natural hairline and real-looking strands.
Lighting: bright, soft, even light across her face with only gentle shading. Shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. 8K vertical portrait-orientation 3:4 aspect ratio.
